stemMd: Which statement cannot be true in any permitted order?

options.label: B
options.textMd: Products and Customers must not occupy consecutive positions.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Products and Customers must occupy consecutive positions, in either order.

explanationMd:
Test whether each proposed statement can be added consistently to the rules. "Orders must be in position 1." is incompatible with every permitted order. The alternative statements each have a complete valid example, given in their feedback. To check impossibility, enumerate placements for the most restricted item or block, then remove every case breaking a rule.

Complete permitted orders (each arrow advances one position):
- Accounts → Products → Branches → Orders → Customers
- Accounts → Products → Customers → Orders → Branches
- Branches → Products → Accounts → Orders → Customers
- Customers → Products → Accounts → Orders → Branches

Orders must not be in position 5. leave 4 valid orders: Accounts>Products>Branches>Orders>Customers; Accounts>Products>Customers>Orders>Branches; Branches>Products>Accounts>Orders>Customers; Customers>Products>Accounts>Orders>Branches.
